extracted.name: Fig and Arugula Salad
extracted.description: This fig and arugula salad recipe, made with fresh figs, arugula, toasted pine nuts, and Parmesan cheese, gets a drizzle of honey and balsamic vinegar.
instruction_lines: Toss arugula, figs, Parmesan cheese, and pine nuts together in a bowl until combined; drizzle with honey and balsamic vinegar before serving.
